description: This file provides compatibility functions and definitions for Windows platforms within a Git environment, including path handling, SSL support, and UTF-8/UTF-16 conversions. It contains inline functions, macro definitions, and function prototypes to facilitate cross-platform compatibility and integration with OpenSSL and Windows-specific APIs.

methods.name: mingw_core_config
methods.description: Configures platform-specific options for MinGW on Windows, acting as a wrapper around a core configuration handler.

methods.name: int mingw_SSL_set_fd(SSL * ssl,int fd)
methods.description: Assigns an OS-level socket handle to an SSL object, adapting the file descriptor for Windows by converting it with _get_osfhandle.

methods.name: int mingw_SSL_set_rfd(SSL * ssl,int fd)
methods.description: Sets the receiving file descriptor for SSL on Windows.

methods.name: int mingw_SSL_set_wfd(SSL * ssl,int fd)
methods.description: Sets the sending file descriptor for SSL on Windows.

methods.name: void convert_slashes(char * path)
methods.description: Converts backslashes in a file path to forward slashes to conform with Unix-style paths.

methods.name: mingw_query_user_email
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's email address configured in Git.

methods.name: is_path_owned_by_current_sid
methods.description: Checks whether a given path is owned by the currently running user, verifying security permissions.

methods.name: is_valid_win32_path
methods.description: Validates Windows file paths against naming rules and restrictions.

methods.name: xutftowcsn
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to UTF-16, handling invalid sequences and encoding issues.

methods.name: int xutftowcs(wchar_t * wcs,const char * utf,size_t wcslen)
methods.description: Simplified conversion from UTF-8 to UTF-16 assuming null-terminated input.

methods.name: int xutftowcs_path(wchar_t * wcs,const char * utf)
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 path to UTF-16, ensuring the buffer size does not overflow.

methods.name: xwcstoutf
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 string to UTF-8, handling surrogate pairs and encoding limits.

methods.name: wmain
methods.description: Main entry point for Unicode command-line argument processing, converting parameters from UTF-16 to UTF-8.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Standard C entry point for the program, compatible with non-Unicode builds.

methods.name: open_in_gdb
methods.description: Launches GDB attached to the current process for debugging.

methods.name: err_win_to_posix
methods.description: Converts Windows error codes to POSIX errno equivalents.

ctags.name: xutftowcs
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int xutftowcs(wchar_t *wcs, const char *utf, size_t wcslen)$/
